install.title: Install Les 2 Palmiers
install.bodyAndroid: Add the app to your home screen for quick access, even offline.
install.bodyIos: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

home.conciergeLede: You're not looking for a driver, a caterer or a nanny in a city you don't know. You ask once. The rest happens at the apartment door.
home.conciergeCaption: A typical day, orchestrated by Les 2 Palmiers.
home.apartmentLede: Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, an open living room and a colonnaded terrace looking over the rooftops and the ocean. Everything is ready: just drop your bags.
home.vCancellation: moderate, free until a few days before
home.servicesLede: Book a service when you reserve, or later from your account. Fixed price where possible, a clear quote otherwise.
home.tourismLede: The coast, the royal palaces, the lagoons, the hills. We arrange the car, the driver and the itinerary — you just look out the window.
home.closingContact: A question before booking? Write to
